title: Refine mobile hierarchy and readability
summary: Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat now share a calmer type scale, tighter spacing and clearer task hierarchy for faster reading during a night shift.
changes: Primary screen titles, section headings and supporting text now use one calmer mobile type scale with more consistent spacing across Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat.
Night keeps the personal assignment as the visual priority while reducing competing emphasis in timeline details, status messaging and the Tonight summary.
Changes now lets completed workflow stages recede and gives unresolved allocation decisions, including the seventh-nurse choice, a clearer and more accessible focus.
Breaks is more compact around pending states and selected-night context so the actual break plan appears sooner without hiding any staffing information.

Chat now uses a compact compose control, denser native-style conversation rows and more disciplined unread/status treatments, while the bottom navigation is easier to read and less visually dominated by Actions.
